title: Okta Organization Security Posture
description: Security posture metrics collected from an Okta organization

collected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data was collected

mfa_coverage.description: Percentage of users with any MFA factor enrolled

mfa_phishing_resistant.description: Percentage of users with phishing-resistant MFA (WebAuthn/FIDO2)

password_expired.description: Percentage of users with expired passwords

locked_out.description: Percentage of users currently locked out

inactive.description: Percentage of users inactive for 90+ days

provisioning_enabled.description: Percentage of apps with automatic user provisioning

deprovisioning_enabled.description: Percentage of apps with automatic user deprovisioning

privileged_access.description: Privileged access counts and MFA coverage

privileged_users_count.description: Count of active users with any effective Okta admin role

super_admin_count.description: Count of active users with the SUPER_ADMIN role

standing_privileged_users_count.description: Count of active users with standing privileged access

privileged_mfa_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of privileged users with any MFA factor enrolled

privileged_phishing_resistant_pct.description: Percentage of privileged users with phishing-resistant MFA

policy.description: Aggregated security policy settings across all active policies

mfa_required_all.description: Whether MFA is required for all non-deprovisioned users after evaluating active policies and rules

mfa_required_any.description: Whether MFA is required for at least one non-deprovisioned user after evaluating active policies and rules

mfa_required_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of non-deprovisioned users covered by an MFA requirement

session_lifetime_min_minutes.description: Shortest session lifetime across active sign-on rules (in minutes)

session_lifetime_max_minutes.description: Longest session lifetime across active sign-on rules (in minutes)

idle_timeout_min_minutes.description: Shortest idle timeout across active sign-on rules (in minutes)

idle_timeout_max_minutes.description: Longest idle timeout across active sign-on rules (in minutes)

managed_device_required.description: Whether any sign-on policy rule requires managed devices

managed_device_required_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of users covered by a managed device requirement

managed_device_required_for_admins.description: Whether all privileged users are covered by a managed device requirement

device_assurance_policies_count.description: Number of device assurance policies defined
